headline: Mail day: the DE 2501 window closes today

sections.lead: The EDD 49-day window shuts today, Mon Nov 23.
items: Mail the signed DE 2501 today: Part A filled, Part B with Dr. Baitoo, Kaiser envelope.
Do it this morning so it beats the counter rush.
Sedgwick's estimated return date is today too; if that's not happening, a quick claim update keeps your file clean.
Dry all day, cloudy: 41°F early, high 53, 0% rain until evening.
Light east wind, 2-6 mph. Good drive-to-the-post-office weather.
Week: rain holds off until Tue night (~0.2"), then Thanksgiving Thu turns partly dry near 60.
Full moon tonight rises right at sunset (3:53 PM, sun sets 4:50).

sections.lead: Full moon night in your rising sign, and Venus lands right on your natal Moon.
items: Plain read: a soft, warm day for people and comfort, and a sky that rewards steady follow-through. Your words get read closely today, so keep them simple and double-check what you sign.
Steady hands: Saturn trines your natal Sun (orb 2.0°). Paperwork energy. This is the transit for finishing the DE 2501 and sending it.
Gentle warmth: Venus conj natal Moon (0.9°) and Sun trine natal Venus (0.9°). Good for small kindnesses, a good meal, easy wins with people.
Watch your words: Mercury opposite your Ascendant (0.3°). Anything you send today gets parsed. Draft, check, then send.
Summary: steady hands, soft heart, careful pen. How to use it: mail the form, keep messages clean, and if the clouds part, catch the full moon rising at sunset.
Details: Moon Taurus 18.6, Sun Sag 1.9, full at 99% (elong 167°); Venus Libra 26.1; Mercury Scorpio 12.2; Saturn R Aries 11.1.
